content:
To query your data with SQL, send HTTP requests to _sql using the following format:
POST domain-endpoint/_plugins/_sql
Sample call
1510
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
{
"query": "SELECT * FROM my-index LIMIT 50"
}
Note
If your domain is running Elasticsearch rather than OpenSearch, the format is
_opendistro/_sql.

hierarchy.parent: Querying your Amazon OpenSearch Service data with SQL
